With FingerprintDoorbell firmware >= v0.9.1 the adapter provisions the device automatically (server mode). For firmware v0.9, paste the URLs below into the device settings manually.
Map each fingerprint to an ioBroker obje: Map each fingerprint to an ioBroker object. On a match the adapter sets/toggles the target. Load the fingerprints from the device, then choose an object and action per row.
Object to set when an unknown finger rin: Object to set when an unknown finger rings. Leave empty to disable.
Value written on ring (e.g. true, 1, on,: Value written on ring (e.g. true, 1, on, or a number/text)

For rows with the 'Alarm' checkbox enabl: For rows with the 'Alarm' checkbox enabled, this object is set in addition to the normal action (panic finger: opens the door as usual and triggers an alarm state).
Object to set when a finger with the Ala: Object to set when a finger with the Alarm flag matches. Leave empty to disable.
Value written to the alarm object (e.g. true, 1, on, or a number/text)
Time-based access windows. A row allows: Time-based access windows. A row allows a finger only on the checked weekdays within the time range. Enable 'Conditions' for a finger in the Fingerprint Actions tab to enforce them. Multiple rows for the same finger are combined with OR. If a finger has 'Conditions' enabled but no matching row, access is denied. Time ranges may cross midnight (e.g. 22:00–06:00).
Time-based access windows. Enter one or: Time-based access windows. Enter one or more finger IDs (comma-separated, e.g. 1,2,4). A row allows those fingers only on the checked weekdays within the time range. Enable 'Conditions' for a finger in the Fingerprint Actions tab to enforce them. Multiple rows for the same finger are combined with OR. If a finger has 'Conditions' enabled but no matching row, access is denied. Time ranges may cross midnight (e.g. 22:00–06:00).
One or more finger IDs, comma-separated: One or more finger IDs, comma-separated (e.g. 1,2,4)
For rows with the 'Snapshot' checkbox en: For rows with the 'Snapshot' checkbox enabled, this object is set in addition to the normal action. Use it to trigger a script that captures a camera snapshot (e.g. ESP32-CAM) and sends it somewhere.
Object to set when a finger with the Sna: Object to set when a finger with the Snapshot flag matches. Leave empty to disable.
Value written to the snapshot object (e.g. true, 1, on, or a number/text)
Backup stores all fingerprint templates: Backup stores all fingerprint templates (id, name, template) in a file on the ioBroker host that survives adapter updates. Restore writes them back to the sensor. Save the settings first so the device connection is available.
Start enrollment directly from ioBroker: Start enrollment directly from ioBroker (firmware >= v0.9.4). Enter a free slot ID (1–200) and a name, then press Start. Place the finger on the sensor 5 times. Watch the progress under the states enroll.status / enroll.step (channel 'enroll'). Save the settings first so the device connection is available.
Loads id → name from the device so you k: Loads id → name from the device so you know which IDs to type into 'Finger ID(s)'. Selection is not saved.
